title.zh: IEA：电池储能继续成为增长最快的电力技术之一
title.en: IEA: battery storage remains one of the fastest-growing power technologies

summary.zh: 国际能源署《Global Energy Review 2026》指出，2025年全球新增电池储能约108 GW，较2024年增长40%，其中约80%为公用事业级项目，LFP电池约占部署量的90%。四小时及以上的储能项目正在增加，说明市场关注点从短时备用扩展到可再生能源消纳和系统灵活性。对工程与基础设施行业而言，电池项目不只是电芯问题，还涉及厂房、消防、热失控隔离、并网设备和全寿命运维。
summary.en: The IEA’s Global Energy Review 2026 reports about 108 GW of new battery storage was deployed worldwide in 2025, 40% above 2024; roughly 80% was utility-scale and LFP cells represented about 90% of deployments. Projects of four hours or more are becoming more common as storage supports renewable integration and system flexibility. For engineering and infrastructure, a battery project is not only a cell problem: buildings, fire protection, thermal-runaway separation, grid equipment, and lifecycle maintenance all matter.

watch.zh: 关注储能项目能否把电化学性能、消防分区和并网可靠性放进同一套工程验收逻辑。
watch.en: Watch whether storage projects bring electrochemical performance, fire separation, and grid reliability into one acceptance framework.

title.zh: IEA：能源技术供应链的薄弱环节正在成为产业投资的核心约束
title.en: IEA: weak links in energy-technology supply chains are becoming a central investment constraint

summary.zh: IEA在《Energy Technology Perspectives 2026》中提出，电池、光伏、风电和电动车供应链虽在扩张，但关键矿物加工和中游制造仍高度集中。报告以N-1供应链分析识别单一最大供应商退出后的缺口，并指出电池出口中断一个月可能使其他地区电动车产量减少约170亿美元。行业启示是，项目可行性不能只看设备报价，还要审查关键材料、替代供应商、交付周期和维修备件的系统弹性。
summary.en: In Energy Technology Perspectives 2026, the IEA finds that supply chains for batteries, solar PV, wind, and electric vehicles are expanding but remain highly concentrated in critical-mineral processing and midstream manufacturing. Its N-1 analysis identifies gaps if the largest supplier is removed; a one-month halt in Chinese battery exports could reduce electric-vehicle output elsewhere by an estimated USD 17 billion. Project feasibility therefore needs more than equipment pricing: it should examine critical materials, alternate suppliers, lead times, and spare-parts resilience.

watch.zh: 关注大型基础设施采购是否把N-1供应链风险转化为可审计的设计和合同条件。
watch.en: Watch whether major infrastructure procurement turns N-1 supply-chain risk into auditable design and contract conditions.

referenceLinks.label: IEA: Supply-chain resilience for key energy technologies

title.zh: Google DeepMind继续把空间推理和工具调用推向真实机器人任务
title.en: Google DeepMind is pushing spatial reasoning and tool use further into real-robot tasks

summary.zh: Google DeepMind在2026年持续更新Gemini Robotics系列，强调机器人对空间关系、工具和多视角环境的理解。对建筑、制造和运维行业而言，价值不只在于让机器人完成单一动作，而在于把感知、规划、执行和安全边界连接起来。真正落地仍要面对现场遮挡、物体变化、人与设备共处以及失败后的人工接管，因此工程部署需要任务分解、可验证的安全状态和清晰的责任边界。
summary.en: Google DeepMind’s 2026 Gemini Robotics work continues to emphasise spatial understanding, tool use, and multi-view reasoning for real-robot tasks. For construction, manufacturing, and maintenance, the value is not merely a single automated motion but the connection of perception, planning, execution, and safety boundaries. Deployment still faces occlusion, changing objects, human-machine coexistence, and recovery after failure, so engineering use needs task decomposition, verifiable safe states, and clear responsibility boundaries.

watch.zh: 关注具身AI能否在非结构化现场提供可验证的安全状态，而不只是展示任务成功率。
watch.en: Watch whether embodied AI can provide verifiable safe states on unstructured sites rather than only impressive task-success rates.

area.zh: 物理引导的地震损伤评估

title.zh: 地震评估正在从单一易损性曲线转向按损伤机制组织的多层级判断
title.en: Seismic assessment is moving from a single fragility curve toward damage-mechanism-based, multilevel decisions

insights.evidence: 2026 structural engineering research on physics-guided seismic assessment of low-rise RC educational facilities

summary.zh: 最新研究把低层钢筋混凝土校舍的地震评估组织为多层级框架，并用层间位移、构件受力和损伤机制相关指标连接结构响应与损伤状态。这个方向对既有建筑和公共资产管理很重要：评估不应只输出一个总体损伤概率，还要说明哪类构造缺陷、构件机制或施工离散性控制结果。对工程师而言，未来能力将包括把非线性分析、现场调查和分级决策整合起来，并明确模型在不同震级、建筑类型和数据质量下的适用边界。
summary.en: Recent research organises seismic assessment of low-rise reinforced-concrete schools into a multilevel framework, linking structural response to damage states through drift, force, and mechanism-related indicators. This matters for existing buildings and public-asset management: an assessment should not output only one overall damage probability but identify which detailing deficiency, member mechanism, or construction variability controls the result. Engineers will need to combine nonlinear analysis, field inspection, and tiered decisions while stating model limits across hazard levels, building types, and data quality.

caveat.zh: 物理引导不等于自动准确；损伤指标、构造信息和地震需求仍需经过校准和现场复核。
caveat.en: Physics-guided does not mean automatically accurate; damage indicators, detailing information, and seismic demand still require calibration and field review.

title.zh: 桥梁研究把维修、寿命和材料创新放到同一个资产管理问题中
title.en: Bridge research is bringing repair, service life, and material innovation into one asset-management problem

insights.evidence: Iowa State Bridge Engineering Center 2026 research portfolio

summary.zh: 美国爱荷华州立大学桥梁工程中心的2026研究计划同时覆盖超高性能混凝土用于钢梁端部维修、桥面性能监测、服役寿命设计以及桥梁湿度控制。它反映出既有桥评估正在从一次性的构件修补，转向“损伤机理—施工方法—监测反馈—剩余寿命”的闭环。对结构工程师而言，材料强度提升只有在界面、收缩、施工窗口、排水和后续检查都能被控制时才会转化为真正的寿命收益。
summary.en: The Iowa State Bridge Engineering Center’s 2026 portfolio covers UHPC repair of steel girder ends, bridge-deck performance monitoring, service-life design, and moisture control for timber bridges. It reflects a shift from one-off component repair toward a loop of damage mechanism, construction method, monitoring feedback, and remaining-life assessment. For structural engineers, higher material strength becomes a real service-life benefit only when interfaces, shrinkage, construction windows, drainage, and follow-up inspection are also controlled.

caveat.zh: 新材料维修的长期优势必须由界面试验、施工质量和现场服役数据共同证明。
caveat.en: Long-term advantages of repair materials must be demonstrated through interface testing, construction quality, and in-service data together.

title.zh: 使用性能研究正在把振动、极端荷载和社区韧性放进同一结构决策框架
title.en: Serviceability research is connecting vibration, extreme loads, and community resilience in one structural decision framework

insights.evidence: Oregon State University structural research programme

summary.zh: 俄勒冈州立大学的结构研究同时关注结构力学与振动行为、地震和海啸下的脆弱性、可解释的数据模型以及多灾种效应。这个组合提醒工程师，结构设计的“性能”不只是极限承载力，也包括日常振动、灾后可恢复性和不同危险源之间的相互作用。对于高层、长跨和关键基础设施，分析流程需要把动力特性、非线性响应、非结构构件和功能恢复目标连接起来，而不是把使用阶段与极端事件完全分开。
summary.en: Oregon State University’s structural programme brings together structural mechanics and vibration behaviour, seismic and tsunami fragility, explainable data models, and multi-hazard effects. It is a reminder that structural performance is not only ultimate resistance; it also includes everyday vibration, post-event recoverability, and interactions between hazards. For tall buildings, long spans, and critical infrastructure, analysis needs to connect dynamic properties, nonlinear response, non-structural components, and recovery objectives rather than separating service conditions from extreme events completely.

caveat.zh: 多灾种框架不能替代具体场地和功能需求；振动限值、损伤状态与恢复目标必须先定义。
caveat.en: A multi-hazard framework does not replace site- and function-specific requirements; vibration limits, damage states, and recovery objectives must be defined first.

title.zh: 混凝土收缩与徐变不是附加修正：中国与国外设计如何处理时间效应？
title.en: Concrete shrinkage and creep are not afterthoughts: how Chinese and international practice treats time effects

text.zh: 混凝土结构的长期变形来自弹性响应、收缩和徐变等机制的叠加。中国、欧洲、澳洲和美国规范在收缩预测、徐变系数、龄期效应、环境条件和构件尺寸上的表达不同，但共同目标是把长期变形转化为裂缝、预应力损失、内力重分配和使用性能判断。设计比较不能只比较一个徐变系数，还要检查材料成熟度、湿度、养护、约束条件和荷载历史。对连续梁、预应力构件和复合结构，时间效应可能改变支点反力、二次内力和变形协调。
text.en: Long-term deformation in concrete structures combines elastic response, shrinkage, and creep. Chinese, European, Australian, and US provisions express shrinkage prediction, creep coefficients, age effects, environmental conditions, and member size differently, but share the goal of translating time-dependent deformation into cracking, prestress loss, force redistribution, and serviceability decisions. A meaningful comparison cannot stop at one creep coefficient; it must consider maturity, humidity, curing, restraint, and load history. In continuous beams, prestressed members, and composite structures, time effects can change support reactions, secondary actions, and compatibility.

label.zh: 收缩是自由变形，约束后才产生应力
label.en: Shrinkage is free deformation until restraint creates stress

text.zh: 同一收缩应变在自由构件中主要表现为变形，在受约束构件中可能转化为拉应力和裂缝风险。
text.en: The same shrinkage strain mainly produces deformation in a free member but can become tensile stress and cracking risk when restrained.

label.zh: 徐变取决于时间和荷载历史
label.en: Creep depends on time and load history

text.zh: 徐变不是一个固定材料常数；加载龄期、持续应力、湿度和截面尺寸都会改变长期响应。
text.en: Creep is not a fixed material constant; loading age, sustained stress, humidity, and member size alter the long-term response.

label.zh: 不同规范的系数不能直接横比
label.en: Coefficients from different codes are not directly interchangeable

text.zh: 各规范的系数可能对应不同的基准、环境和有效龄期，必须先统一定义再比较。
text.en: Coefficients may use different bases, environments, and effective ages; definitions must be aligned before comparison.

takeaway.zh: 中外规范的共同逻辑是：先定义自由收缩和持续荷载，再根据约束、龄期、环境和截面条件求长期变形，最后把结果带入裂缝、预应力、内力重分配和挠度验算。
takeaway.en: The shared logic is to define free shrinkage and sustained loading, evaluate long-term deformation using restraint, age, environment, and section conditions, then carry the result into cracking, prestress, redistribution, and deflection checks.

title.zh: 参考实例：时间效应的概念分解与长期应变筛查
title.en: Worked reference: decomposing time effects and screening long-term strain

intro.zh: 以下为概念分解和派生关系，不是某一规范的编号公式。正式设计应按适用规范确定收缩、徐变、龄期调整、环境参数、约束和荷载历史。
intro.en: The relations below are conceptual decompositions and derived relations, not numbered equations from one standard. Formal design must obtain shrinkage, creep, age adjustment, environmental parameters, restraint, and load history from the applicable provisions.

citation.zh: Derived relation：将总应变εₜ分解为弹性、收缩和徐变分量；具体组合须按荷载历史和规范模型定义。
citation.en: Derived relation: decomposes total strain εₜ into elastic, shrinkage, and creep components; the applicable code model defines the combination for the load history.

label.zh: 徐变系数定义（概念定义）

citation.zh: Conceptual definition：φ表示给定加载龄期t₀和时间t下的徐变应变与初始弹性应变之比；ACI 209.2R与EN 1992-1-1采用各自模型确定其取值。
citation.en: Conceptual definition: φ is the ratio of creep strain to initial elastic strain for loading age t₀ and time t; ACI 209.2R and EN 1992-1-1 provide their own models for evaluating it.

label.zh: 有效模量筛查（派生关系）

citation.zh: Derived relation：用于说明徐变对等效刚度的概念影响；不能替代规范中的龄期调整、开裂、非线性和约束分析。
citation.en: Derived relation: illustrates the conceptual effect of creep on equivalent stiffness; it does not replace code-specific age adjustment, cracking, nonlinear, or restraint analysis.

note.zh: 例如，若某一概念筛查取εₑ=0.40‰、εₛₕ=0.25‰、φ=2.0，则ε𝚌ᵣ=φ·εₑ=0.80‰，总应变εₜ≈1.45‰。这只是应变分解示例，未考虑开裂、钢筋约束、温度、预应力、截面有效刚度和内力重分配。
note.en: For example, with εₑ=0.40‰, εₛₕ=0.25‰, and φ=2.0 for a conceptual screen, ε𝚌ᵣ=φ·εₑ=0.80‰ and εₜ≈1.45‰. This is only a strain-decomposition example; it does not include cracking, reinforcement restraint, temperature, prestress, effective section stiffness, or force redistribution.

referenceLinks.label: ACI: Guide for Modeling and Calculating Shrinkage and Creep in Hardened Concrete
